subject: general
question: In which of the following states is Nishagandhi Nritya Utsav' celebrated?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kerala.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Nishagandhi Nritya Utsav is celebrated for seven nights of unlimited entertainment of folk dance and exhibitions.
 
• It is celebrated twice aa year, respectively in the month of October and March in the Nishagandhi theatre, Trivandrum.
 
• Each year this festival of dance is conducted in the Kanakakunnu Palace which is located in Trivandrum and is close to the Napier Museum.
 
• **Trivandrum or Thiruvananthapuram **is the **capital** of the Kerala state.
 
• Therefore, the Nishagandhi Nritya Ustav is celebrated in Kerala.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• During this dance festival, **renowned performers** of Bharatanatyam, Mohiniyattam, Kathak, Odissi, modern ballet, and other folk forms from **around the nation** take the stage at Nishagandhi's outdoor theatre.
 
• This festival includes performers who are dedicated to highlighting the rich diversity of **Indian tradition.**
 
• The festival typically includes classical, instrumental, or fusion music, and **admission is completely free.**
 
• Numerous dignitaries and well-known celebrities also attend this gathering.
 
• People travel to Kerala just for this festival from various cities and states.
